The '''Isttu Galactic Bank''' was located aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] in [[Isttu Village]]. It provided local banking services, include secure vaults and connection to the [[Imperial Galactic Bank/Legends|Imperial Galactic Bank]] for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] transfers. A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the bank was the target of a robbery by a gang of [[Thief/Legends|thieves]].
